content.title: IBM's Price Target Lowered to $290 by BMO Capital on March 19, 2
content.text: Key Takeaways BMO Capital maintains IBM's rating at 'Market Perform' while lowering the price target from $350 to $290. Significant price target adjustments have featured prominently in recent analyst ratings for IBM.In today's analyst rating update, IBM IBM saw its price target lowered by BMO Capital. Analyst Keith Bachman maintained a 'Market Perform' rating on the stock, adjusting the price target from a previous $350 to $290. This change represents a decrease of 17.14% in the expected price target, reflecting current market assessments.The adjustments by BMO follow a series of recent evaluations by other analysts:On March 18, 2026, JP Morgan analyst Brian Essex maintained a 'Neutral' rating on IBM, lowering the price target from $317 to $283, a 10.73% decrease. On February 25, 2026, UBS upgraded IBM from 'Sell' to 'Neutral', maintaining the price target at $236. Also on February 25, 2026, Wedbush reiterated its 'Outperform' rating on IBM, maintaining a price target of $340. On February 25, 2026, Morgan Stanley's Erik Woodring maintained an 'Equal-Weight' rating, lowering the price target from $304 to $247, an 18.75% decrease. Earlier, on January 29, 2026, Evercore ISI Group raised the price target from $330 to $345, maintaining an 'Outperform' rating.The latest ratings indicate variability in analysts' expectations and reflect ongoing volatility in IBM's market outlook.Incorporated in 1911, International Business Machines, or IBM, is one of the oldest technology companies in the world. It provides software, IT consulting services, and hardware to help business customers modernize their technology workflows. IBM operates in 175 countries and employs approximately 300,000 people. The company has a robust roster of business partners to service its clients, which includes 95% of all Fortune 500 companies. IBMs products, including Red Hat, watsonx, and mainframes, handle some of the worlds most important data workloads in areas like finance and retail.Wall Street Analysts Forecast Based on the one-year price targets offered by 20 analysts, the average target price for International Business Machines Corp IBM is $308.00 with a high estimate of $380.00 and a low estimate of $218.00. The average target implies an upside of 22.42% from the current price of $251.60.
